headline: Sonic the Hedgehog - Sega's answer to Mario
title: The Story of Sonic the Hedgehog | Sega's Answer to Mario | Classic Games
video_script: In nineteen ninety one, Sega released Sonic the Hedgehog on the Sega Genesis to challenge Nintendo's Mario. The game was made by Sonic Team, with programmer Yuji Naka and designer Naoto Ohshima. Its blazing speed made Sonic an instant icon, and a blue hedgehog became Sega's mascot. Sonic or Mario? Comment below!
description: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) was Sega's mascot answer to Mario on the Sega Genesis, made by Yuji Naka and Naoto Ohshima.
